posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared a tender May photo dump with husband Vicky Kaushal and baby Vihaan, offering fans a rare glimpse into her growing family life.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Riding global momentum, Diljit was honoured with 'Diljit Dosanjh Day' (Jan 6, 2027) by the LA City Council as his Imtiaz Ali film Main Vaapas Aaunga draws warm reviews in theatres.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: The Alpha trailer dropped on June 17 — Alia headlines YRF's first female-led Spy Universe film alongside Sharvari and Bobby Deol, hitting screens July 3.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Newly named a Rolex Testimonee and ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026, Priyanka is currently shooting SS Rajamouli's Varanasi.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King is officially rolling — SRK began the Siddharth Anand-directed actioner in Mumbai on May 21, with Deepika, Abhishek Bachchan and Anil Kapoor on board for a Christmas 2026 release.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena wrapped Meghna Gulzar's Daayra opposite Prithviraj Sukumaran, set for a September 18 release, amid buzz about a Raj-DK project with Salman Khan.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Riding the runaway success of the Stree franchise, Shraddha continues to top engagement charts as one of Bollywood's most-followed stars on Instagram.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika made history as the first Indian citizen named to the Hollywood Walk of Fame Class of 2026, and joins Allu Arjun in Atlee's sci-fi spectacle AA22xA6.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Dhurandhar juggernaut rolls on — Dhurandhar 2 is now the third highest-grossing Indian film ever (₹1,780 Cr worldwide) and is headed for a Japan release.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: The eternal style icon continues to command global attention with her red-carpet appearances and timeless presence on the international stage.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon released June 19, while she and husband Vijay Deverakonda announced their period drama Ranabaali.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha continues to balance acting and producing, building her Tralala Moving Pictures banner while staying a fan favourite across South and Hindi cinema.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun teamed up with director Atlee and Deepika Padukone for AA22xA6, an ambitious sci-fi film set across parallel universes.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's Peddi crossed ₹256 Cr gross since its June 4 release, with makers adding nearly six minutes of new scenes amid box-office momentum.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's War 2 with Hrithik Roshan locks August 14 — the first-look teaser launched on his birthday (May 20) and Telugu distribution deals are breaking records.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi cheered on the Alpha trailer and was reportedly approached for the Tumbbad director's creature-horror film, with Lag Ja Gale opposite Tiger Shroff lined up for 2027.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya rang in her 27th birthday with heartfelt wishes from cousins Suhana and Shanaya Kapoor and aunt Kareena Kapoor Khan.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara makes her Spy Universe debut in War 2 (releasing August 14) — set to become her fifth 100-crore film.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik's green-eyed cameo as Kabir teased in the Alpha trailer set fans abuzz, ahead of his War 2 face-off with Jr NTR on August 14.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai — father David Dhawan's final directorial — released June 5, with Bhediya 2 arriving August 14.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released the female version of 'Nabz Nabz' on June 11 and dropped a live album from her All Hearts Tour, delighting fans worldwide.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman unveiled the full album of Main Vaapas Aaunga, his Imtiaz Ali collaboration featuring Diljit Dosanjh, sparking fresh debate about his evolving sound.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Balancing his political journey with cinema, Vijay gears up for Jana Nayagan as his TVK party reshapes Tamil Nadu's political landscape.
